title: MRR MethodProtocol
description: docs/spec/08_RESEARCH_METHOD_KERNEL.md (status ACCEPTED, 2026-07-21) section 3's object table, AS AMENDED (commit 1d453bf, 'Spec-08-Amendment MethodProtocol-Re-Review-Zyklus'): 'MethodProtocol | the lockable commitment document of a profile ...: criteria, rules, analyses, kill conditions | draft -> reviewed -> locked -> amended | executed; amended -> reviewed (re-review cycle)'. Third and heaviest of the six task-packets/K1-T01.yaml entities — see mrr.domain.lifecycles.METHOD_PROTOCOL_LIFECYCLE for the state machine this amendment produces. MRR-MTH-007: locking binds the exact content hash, actor, and time — realized here NOT as a new, separately-computed field, but as this locked revision's own baseObject.content_hash (ADR-0004) plus two new body fields recording the two facts content_hash alone does not carry: locked_by and locked_at (task-packets/K1-T01.yaml derived_decisions). MRR-MTH-008: post-lock changes MUST be amendments — a new revision recording reason, actor, and whether outcome information had been observed; realized as the nested 'amendment' object, non-null exactly when status == 'amended'. MRR-MTH-010: at least one kill condition is required. 'sensitivity_variations' is intended as a list of ConceptCharterEntry.entry_id values (MTH-018) — this cross-object reference is not validated here (service-level, deferred).

outcome_information_observed.description: MRR-MTH-008: whether outcome information had been observed at the time of this amendment. An outcome-informed amendment demotes affected analyses to exploratory — that demotion itself is NOT implemented here (service-level, K1-T02/K1-T03); this field only makes the fact machine-recordable.

amended_locked_content_hash.description: An explicit back-reference to the exact locked revision's own content_hash being amended, letting a reader confirm precisely which locked commitment changed without a revision-history walk.

profile_id.description: The MethodProfile this protocol commits to. A plain body field, never an edge (task-packets/K1-T02.yaml's job); not validated to resolve to an accepted MethodProfile here (service-level, deferred).

extraction_fields.description: Named fields a governed EvidenceMatrix row's 'extraction' map is keyed by (not cross-validated against them here — service-level, deferred). Present but not required non-empty.

sensitivity_variations.description: MTH-018: intended as a list of ConceptCharterEntry.entry_id values naming the varied classifications a sensitivity analysis runs over. Not cross-validated against a real ConceptCharter here (service-level, deferred).

planned_analyses.description: Required non-empty — a protocol with zero planned analyses would have nothing for a later MethodRuling to rule on.

kill_conditions.description: MRR-MTH-010: every MethodProtocol MUST declare at least one kill condition. Declared data only — no transition-triggering logic (task-packets/K1-T02.yaml's job).

locked_at.description: MRR-MTH-007. Non-null exactly when status is one of locked/amended/executed; null when status is draft/reviewed.

locked_by.description: MRR-MTH-007. Non-null exactly when status is one of locked/amended/executed; null when status is draft/reviewed.

amendment.description: MRR-MTH-008. Non-null exactly when status == 'amended'; null for every other status.

status.description: Lifecycle status, as amended (commit 1d453bf): draft -> reviewed -> locked -> amended | executed; amended -> reviewed (re-review cycle). See mrr.domain.lifecycles.METHOD_PROTOCOL_LIFECYCLE.
